purpose: Remove the floating-object / texture-cutout look at interfaces by reconstructing physical grade transitions rather than painting dark borders into albedo.

materials.materialFamily: cementitious protective plinth mortar over reinforced-concrete base
materials.finish: trowelled mineral surface with fine aggregate, low sheen, no baked shadow
materials.microstructure: 0.5-3 mm sand/trowel variation; larger chips remain geometry only when physically justified
materials.wetResponse: lower roughness and modestly darken only at rain/ground-splash exposure
materials.uvAging: small warm/cool mineral drift; no painted sun highlights
materials.frontLightResponse: broad diffuse response with weak dielectric highlight
materials.grazingLightResponse: slightly stronger Fresnel edge response reveals trowel micro-normal without reading metallic
materials.shadeResponse: retains local aggregate contrast without artificial ambient glow

materials.materialFamily: fine mineral soil accumulated/compacted at hardscape and vegetation edges
materials.microstructure: 1-8 mm granular breakup; no repeated painted border
materials.wetResponse: darkens modestly and becomes smoother only where runoff/splash reaches it
materials.uvAging: dry exposed grains lighten slightly, sheltered pockets stay darker
materials.grazingLightResponse: grain relief catches small broad highlights, never a continuous glossy strip
materials.shadeResponse: keeps granular form readable through sky fill

materials.materialFamily: recessed mineral joint/fines between constructed elements
materials.finish: recessed matte joint carrying trapped fines
materials.wetResponse: slightly darker with localized roughness reduction in retained moisture
materials.uvAging: minimal because the recess is sheltered
materials.frontLightResponse: low diffuse value with no fake AO painted outside the actual recess
materials.grazingLightResponse: physical recess/self-shadowing dominates over specular response
materials.shadeResponse: remains dark due to geometry and material, not baked directional lighting

assemblies.nominalDimensions: front plinth 26.0 m long x 0.14 m high x 0.12 m projection; shoulder roughly 0.18 m wide; 12 mm isolation joint
assemblies.manufacture: reinforced-concrete building base with later protective mortar/plinth finish; exterior grade is compacted against the base after structural work
assemblies.mounting: plinth is bonded/continuous with building base; grade shoulder bears on ground and must not float above it
assemblies.interfaces: facade-to-plinth top edge, plinth-to-grade contact, stair-tower construction joint, runoff/splash zone
assemblies.orientationExposure: camera-facing south/southeast facade, rain exposed, partly sun exposed, direct ground splash at lowest band
assemblies.aging: soil splash and moisture concentrate within roughly 0.4 m of grade; the recessed isolation joint retains darker fines
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: plinth projection, return and joint are geometry; mineral grain/roughness is material response; stains require physical sources
assemblies.lookdevBrief: 4K front and grazing-light crops must show a physical toe, contact shadow, joint depth and non-metallic mineral response without a pasted dark line

assemblies.nominalDimensions: edge shoulder varies approximately 0.03-0.08 m in visible width and 0.005-0.025 m in relief; variation is gradual rather than every identical module
assemblies.manufacture: hardscape/curb is installed first; topsoil/vegetation is graded to it, leaving a narrow compacted soil/fines transition from maintenance and runoff
assemblies.mounting: transition follows the real curb/path boundary and stays slightly below the hard edge
assemblies.interfaces: grass/soil to curb, paving to curb, runoff from hard surface to absorptive soil
assemblies.orientationExposure: upward-facing rain/sun exposure with strongest splash at curb low edge
assemblies.aging: fine soil accumulates in low spots; grass edge is not a perfectly straight painted mask; exposed sections dry faster than recesses
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: edge relief/width changes are geometry; grain and moisture are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: oblique 4K crop should lose the razor-straight texture boundary while keeping drainage/curb construction readable

assemblies.nominalDimensions: erosion shoulder approximately 0.05-0.16 m wide, 0.005-0.03 m vertical relief, varying over 0.35-0.80 m wavelengths
assemblies.manufacture: unsealed desire path forms by repeated foot traffic compressing vegetation/topsoil rather than by a poured edge
assemblies.mounting: the tread is continuous with grade; no artificial curb is added where the path should remain informal
assemblies.interfaces: compacted soil to grass, footfall wear zone to less disturbed verge
assemblies.orientationExposure: upward-facing, rain and sun exposed, foot-traffic concentrated
assemblies.aging: edge broadens where feet clip vegetation and narrows where growth recovers; low pockets retain moisture/fines
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: irregular edge silhouette/relief is geometry; soil granularity and moisture variation are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: 100% crop must read as an organically worn edge rather than a rectangular soil decal

hardFailIf: contract claims runtime render verification without real Unity evidence
contact strip is floating above the underlying grade
hard black border is painted into albedo to fake contact
worn path receives a perfectly uniform rectangular shoulder
generated interface detail adds gameplay colliders
contact assembly is missing before the 4K benchmark capture
